svg.title: Prometaphase and Metaphase
svg.desc: Six duplicated chromosomes are exposed as the nuclear envelope fragments. Kinetochore fibers attach to chromosomes; nonkinetochore fibers overlap. Six individual chromosomes align at a single metaphase plate with bipolar attachments. Original unmeasured animal-cell schematics after lecture 06B source figures. Purple denotes chromosomes; yellow denotes microtubules and centrosomes. Counts of chromatin loops and spindle fibers are illustrative.
